issues.description: Multiple \footnote entries are used inside the itemize environment. While legal in LaTeX, this sometimes produces awkward spacing/numbering depending on the document class and can complicate automated processing of the LaTeX body.
issues.required_fix: Either move the footnotes to the paragraph following the itemize (collecting citations there) or convert inline citations to parenthetical source tags (e.g., [Source: kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2]) if the build system prefers. Ensure consistent footnote numbering and compilation.
